description: Initiate a rest sequence for the party. Recovers HP and stress, advances game time, and optionally clears conditions. Sets the UI stage to 'rest'. Returns an envelope with `outcome` ('short_rest', 'long_rest', or 'camp_rest') and a one-line `summary` as the headline; per-character mechanics in `result.results`, totals in `state_delta`.

flavor.description: Flavor text for the rest scene

restType.description: Type of rest: short (1h, 25% HP, short-rest stress recovery — default 2), long (8h, 50% HP, long-rest stress recovery — default all), camp (12h, full HP, long-rest stress recovery). The world's stressConfig sets the stress amounts.

name: take_rest
